disclosureQuote: The game's core content was created through extensive manual development. The main character, outfits, and all Live2D models are entirely hand-drawn, manually rigged, animated, and polished by the developer. AI was used only as a limited production aid for a small number of UI illustrations, some optional Gacha characters (which were extensively edited, layered, animated, and refined by hand), store images,and the soundtrack.
summary: 桌面伴侣应用，2026 年 9 月 17 日由 DigitalDream 发行。开发者称核心内容由大量手工开发完成，主角、服装与全部 Live2D 模型均为手绘与手工绑定，而 AI 只作为有限辅助，用在少量 UI 插画、部分可选抽卡角色、商店图与原声音乐上。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商同为 DigitalDream）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 160），首页有 1 个被自动匹配为相关的主题（“AI Companion node.js”），已逐帖读取原文：这是玩家求助本作新出的 AI Companion 扩展 DLC 里外部 AI 代理（Gemini CLI）无法启动的问题，跟帖有带 developer 徽章的官方回复表示会调查修复；内容属技术支持与外部工具的可用性，没有说明该功能在运行时生成什么，因此按规则只登记不判定，不改变游戏内实时生成等任何领域结论。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源：六条结果是本作商店页与另一个商店页入口、带鉴赏家参数的社区中心页、Instagram 上的预告片转发（读不到正文）、西语相似游戏列表与俄语比价页，均不含第三方对 AI 披露的核实内容；检索范围仅限工具实际返回的内容，不能据此认定没有其他公开报道。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。披露以“only … limited production aid”限定规模并声明主角与 Live2D 全手工，但这些仍是开发者自述，本站据此把美术、音乐、营销登记为已使用，其余五个领域按未提及处理。
description: 住在桌面上的成熟女性伴侣：看硬件、排任务、管钱、收集宠物、放音乐与装饰桌面，外观和服装都能自己调。

english.summary: A desktop companion application released by DigitalDream on Sep 17, 2026. The developer states that the core content was built by hand, with the main character, outfits and all Live2D models entirely hand-drawn and manually rigged, and that AI was a limited production aid used for a small number of UI illustrations, some optional Gacha characters, store images and the soundtrack.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer and publisher DigitalDream) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 160), where one topic matched the AI keyword screen; it was opened and read in full. The post is a player asking why the external AI agent bundled with this title's AI Companion expansion, running Gemini CLI, will not start, and a reply carrying the developer badge says the issue will be investigated. It concerns the availability of a third-party agent rather than what content is generated at run time, so it is logged without changing any area finding, including in-game generation. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 0 raw sources were read because all six were the store page and a second store entry, the community hub with a curator parameter, an Instagram trailer share with no readable body, a Spanish similar-games list and a Russian price comparison page, none of which verifies the disclosure; that describes the search range and is not proof that no other coverage exists. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit: the wording only as a limited production aid and the hand-drawn Live2D claim are the developer's own, art, music and marketing are recorded as used for the assets actually named, and the other five areas stay recorded as not addressed.
